Membership How to use Services Discover Friends of the National Library Contact Us X Who Can Use The Library Students and Academics Access study materials, academic journals, and resources to support learning, teaching, and research. Researchers and Professionals Utilize specialized collections, data, and references for in-depth research and professional development. Government Officers and Policy Makers Find reliable information, reports, and archives to support decision-making and policy development. School Children and Lifelong Learners Explore books, educational programs, and resources that encourage reading and continuous learning. General Public and Foreign Visitors Enjoy access to a wide range of books, cultural materials, and information about local heritage and knowledge.
